texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的神秘机器人对我们的殖民者从一落足于行星上起就非常欢迎。我们的许多定居者一开始不信任这个小机器人，但它对我们建立殖民地的过程难以置信地有帮助，并且在其中扮演了重要角色。

在头几年的殖民过程中，这个小东西在[Root.GetName]上的第一座城市诞生了衍生形象，并成为了整颗行星的吉祥物。
texts.en:
The enigmatic creature on [Root.GetName] has been very welcoming to our colonists after they settled down on the planet. At first many of our settlers were distrustful of the small robot, but it has shown itself to be incredibly helpful and has played a key role in establishing the colony.

Following the first years of the colony, the small thing has become something of a pet figure in the first cities on [Root.GetName], and a mascot for the planet as a whole.

label.zh: 这可爱的小机器人帮助了我们真多。
label.en: How nice of the little creature to help us out.

texts.zh:
这座由[Root.GetName]上的小机器人监管的工厂在殖民地建立的最初几年起到了重要作用。现在这些定居者们终于得以有时间了解他们的小吉祥物以及理解它不寻常的行为，他们了解到它看护了数个世纪的这座老旧的建筑已经残破不堪，并需要比它所能提供的更多的帮助。

尽管它的远古工程和机械对我们而言仍很陌生，但我们的工程师认为他们应该可以修好，只是需要一点时间。
texts.en:
The factory supervised by the little robot on [Root.GetName] has been instrumental for the colony in its early years. Now that the settlers have had time to get to know their mascot and understand its uncommon mannerisms, they have learnt that the old building it has taken care of for centuries is falling apart and needs more help than the creature can give it on its own.

Though its ancient engineering and machinery are still foreign to us, our engineers think they should be able to fix it, given time.

label.zh: 那就让我们看看能不能帮上它。
label.en: Let us see if we can help it out then.

texts.zh: 在数年的缓慢剥蚀中，[Root.GetName]上的这座巨大工厂终于彻底瓦解。在清理完这座老建筑的废墟后，我们的殖民者发现了一个巨大的金属堆隐藏在原来建筑物中可能是地下室的位置。在它的正中央静静地躺着那个过去快乐地欢迎着我们来到这颗星球的机器人，它在这座它负责监管的工厂的倒塌过程中被压毁了。
texts.en: After years of slow decline, the great factory on [Root.GetName] has finally fallen apart. After clearing out all the debris from the old building, our colonists came across large piles of metal hidden away in what would have been the basement when it was still standing. In the middle of it all lies the robot that once so happily welcomed our settlers to the planet, crushed by the factory it was responsible for supervising.

texts.zh:
据报告，伴随着所有设备的突然停转，我们的工程师确信他们未能在[Root.GetName]上修复这座古老的工厂。由于未能找到失败的原因，他们开始放下工具离开大楼。就在这时引擎突然轰鸣起来。

不仅发动机重新工作了，而且我们的工程师似乎也意外地修复了工厂的其余部分——尽管还不清楚这是如何发生的。他们的报告最后还提到了一个小机器人，它看到工厂重新开始运作后跳起了奇怪的舞蹈。
texts.en:
Our engineers were certain they had failed at fixing the ancient factory on [Root.GetName], according to their report, when everything suddenly stopped. Unsure how they had managed to fail they began putting aside their tools and exiting the building, when suddenly the engine roared to life.

Not only is the engine working again, but our engineers seem to have accidentally managed to fix other parts of the factory as well - though it is unclear how that happened. Their report ends with a small description of the weird dance the little robot did when it saw its factory working again.

texts.zh:
我们收到了[Root.GetName]上的人员的报告，似乎他们行星上的神秘机器人又带来了麻烦。最近它失踪了，它失踪的同时，恰好一些殖民者被报道从该行星上的一个城市消失。

虽然这两件事最初被认为是无关的，但人们已经开始将他们朋友和家人的失踪归咎于这个机器人。我们的工程师正在扫描该机器人所在的工厂自事故发生以来收到的几个信号，看看是否这些信号能发回这个机器人。
texts.en:
We have received a report from the people of [Root.GetName], as it seems once again they are having trouble with the enigmatic robot on their planet. Recently it has gone missing, and its disappearance coincides with the reports of several colonists vanishing from one of the cities on the planet.

Though they were originally assumed to be unrelated, people have started blaming the creature for their missing friends and family. Our engineers are looking into scanning several signals that the robot's factory has received since the incident, to see if it leads back to the creature itself.

label.zh: 希望我们能解决这个问题，越快越好。
label.en: Let us hope we can solve this as quickly as possible.

texts.zh:
在花费数周尝试追踪[Root.GetName]上的机器人的信号后，我们的工程师终于发现了一座深入地下的远古竖井。在地面下的深处，他们看到了一座远古的建筑，多数的失踪人口都在锁在其中，同时还有小机器人的残留物。

在唤醒了这些殖民者之后，我们发现他们都是某个教团的成员，意外地落入了这座废墟，当小机器人来试图解救他们的时候一切都开始崩塌。我们的工程师和这些人自己都不清楚到底是怎么陷入这个地方的，也不知道是什么东西停止了建筑的崩塌。

我们的工程师对深入研究那个已经损坏的神秘机器很感兴趣，想知道能从中获得什么信息。而另一方面，[Root.GetName]的人们则期望我们可以将这个小东西修复，变回原来的样子。
texts.en:
After spending weeks trying to track down the signals from the robot on [Root.GetName], our engineers have finally found an ancient shaft leading deep into the ground. Far below ground they came across an ancient structure with most of the missing people locked in some form of stasis, as well as the remains of the little robot.

After waking the colonists, we learn that all of them are part of some cult that managed to accidentally make their way into the ruins, and that everything was about to collapse on them when the little robot came to their rescue. It seems unclear to both our engineers and the people themselves exactly how they found themselves in a stasis, or what the creature did to stop the collapse of the building.

Our engineers are interested in looking into the enigmatic machine now that it is no longer functional, to see what we can learn from it. The people of [Root.GetName], on the other hand, are pleading with us to see if we can restore the little creature back to its former self.

label.zh: 那就把大家的小吉祥物变回来。
label.en: Let the people have their little mascot back, then.

label.zh: 让工程师把它拆了看看里面有什么秘密。
label.en: Have the engineers break it apart and see what mysteries it holds.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的这座工厂已荒废颓败了数个世纪，仿佛随时都要垮塌得支离破碎。它在行星的殖民地建立之初曾扮演过重要的作用，我们的殖民家出面并要求我们进入这座工厂，并使其修复如新，恢复往日荣光。

回报：£alloys£合金
texts.en:
The factory on [Root.GetName] has been decaying for centuries already, and is reaching a point where it might fall apart at any moment. As it has played an instrumental role in the foundation of the colony on the planet, our colonists have reached out and asked us to step in and make sure the building will be restored to former glory.

Reward: £alloys£ Alloys

texts.zh: 在这座星球上生活的机器人最近消失了，其他的许多殖民者也是如此。我们的工程师正在试图搜寻它们最近的信号以溯源，来看看我们能不能找到这些殖民者和机器人。
texts.en: The robot inhabiting the planet has recently disappeared - as has a large number of our colonists. Our engineers are looking into tracking its remote signals back to the source, to see if we can find the colonists and the robot.
